story.title: My Story
story.p1: Hi! I'm a student developer specializing in building modern web applications. My passion for programming started a few years ago when I built my very first website.
story.p2: Since then, I've been constantly learning and growing, exploring new technologies and frameworks. I love turning concepts into reality through code, creating applications that look stunning and perform flawlessly.
story.p3: I believe in the power of great design and clean code. Every project is an opportunity for me to craft something distinct and valuable for users.

q1.question: How long does it take to get a response?
q1.answer: Usually, I respond within 24 hours on business days.

q2.question: What kind of projects do you accept?
q2.answer: I am open to web development, UI/UX design, and frontend consultations.

q3.question: Do you work remotely?
q3.answer: Yes, I work remotely with clients from all over the world.
